flags.title: The brief's two High-pick conditions contradicted each other; the band now governs
flags.detail: Taken together, "more than 70% to win" and "fair price between -250 and +10000" leave only the 1.4-point slice from -250 to -233, which is why earlier desks published zero High picks. This desk treats the -250..+10000 band as the hard rule (0.99% to 71.4% implied) and adds its own minimum of 60% for High. A selection cannot be High just for being a short market favourite: anything shorter than -250 is excluded by the band.

flags.title: Thirteen of the fifteen requested sports carry no priced match today
flags.detail: Every sport is listed on the site with the link to its own OLBG hub, but only ice hockey and baseball had an official fixture-and-record source that could be read and parsed this session. NBA and EuroLeague feeds returned errors, the ATP scores page showed only matches already in progress, and the remaining federations publish no machine-readable fixture list. Nothing was filled in from memory.

flags.detail: The league feed reports twelve games on 24 October and five on 25 October. Eleven and four respectively were captured with start, venue and both clubs. Minnesota @ Seattle and one further 25 October game were not reached. They are listed as gaps, not as rows with a guessed time.

flags.title: Injury and lineup news is not included anywhere in this desk
flags.detail: No official injury report, transaction wire or confirmed starting lineup was read for any of these matches. Rather than describe unread team news, every write-up sticks to records, scoring and splits that are on the cited page. Where a total would need a starting pitcher, the market is withheld instead of estimated.

flags.title: The published market price is the league feed's, not a bookmaker screenshot

They are used only for comparison; no originated price is copied from them, and no claim of a betting edge is made where our price is the longer of the two.
